content_fields.title: Test that APIs do not expose sensitive information
content_fields.description: Stop returning process environment, filesystem and path information through the API.
content_fields.finding: The debug response embeds the full process environment plus the working directory, sys.path and a directory listing, exposing internal configuration and secrets through an API.
criteria: No route returns `os.environ`, `sys.path`, `os.getcwd()` or a directory listing.
An unauthenticated request to any diagnostic path returns 401 or 404.
